notes.title: Demo update 1.041 is here!
notes.notes:
Update & Changes in this Demo update:

Adjusted day & night cycle for better balance and immersion.
Enhanced enemy AI and pathfinding for smarter adversaries.
Money Crates now respawn for continuous resource gathering.
Increased currency yield from crystal deposits for greater rewards.
Optimized colonists' movements and speeds for smoother gameplay.
